verdict.rationale: The guidance on justica.gov.pt/Servicos/Empresa-Online was evidently readable: many verbatim passages (entity types, authentication routes, fees, steps) were extracted from it. That suggests no blocking wall in front of the reading surface. However, the published eportugal.gov.pt entry path returns HTTP 404, and no probe confirms how the justica.gov.pt page responds to a keyless agent with an identified user agent. Missing for 10: a direct probe showing HTTP 200 on the guidance page with a standard identified UA, confirmation of server-rendered content rather than a JS-only shell, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot challenge, and a working published entry URL instead of the 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service's published guidance pages are reachable by a keyless agent with a standard identified user agent — no bot wall, JS-only shell, or CAPTCHA in front of the public reading surface
